candidate_missed_obligations_to_test_by_.question: Does every arbitrary CNF state admit at least one theorem-bearing exact transition or certified terminal leaf without heuristic selection?
Can CNF, ACI, affine, 2SAT, symmetric-weight and swap-orbit states that encode the same Boolean relation be recognized and merged in polynomial time by proof-carrying cross-language certificates?
After heuristic variable ordering is forbidden, is arbitrary pivot choice safe, or can all exact pivot branches be quotient-compressed to polynomially many transition states?
Is the number M(N) of non-equivalent exact transition states polynomial for arbitrary CNF?
Are all nine cumulative cost coordinates polynomial across the full n-step existential chain, including failed exact-domain checks and certificate bytes?
Can every representation switch and equivalence certificate used by the universal route be discovered and built in polynomial time rather than merely verified in polynomial time?
Is there a formally proved composition theorem for arbitrary mixtures of the active representation languages, not only locally checked pairs?
Do SAT witnesses and UNSAT certificates compose through every allowed representation-switch chain with polynomial total size and replay cost?

Can exact representation switches cycle across different languages without syntactic state repetition, and if so what exact well-founded measure prevents infinite or superpolynomial internal switching?
Does the exact language union remain closed under every next existential projection for arbitrary CNF without decompression to exponential state?
